Frequently Asked Questions

Is Aga Khan University better than JSMU?

Both Aga Khan University and Jinnah Sindh Medical University are HEC-recognized universities. Aga Khan University is private (est. 1983) in Karachi, while JSMU is public (est. 1973) in Karachi. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between Aga Khan University and JSMU?

Aga Khan University's fee is approximately Rs. 8L–2.5M/year per semester, while JSMU's is Rs. 50–80K/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for Aga Khan University and JSMU?

Aga Khan University: Merit + AKU Admission Test + interview. Program-specific tests for MBBS, Nursing. Criteria: academic record, critical reasoning, English fluency, interview, extracurriculars.. JSMU: 80%+ aggregate (MDCAT).
